title: 第九章 可我想回家……
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“好吧，既然你不恨他们，那我就不说这些了。”

“我先前的提议，姐姐还记得吧。”

“我说了，要让你感受到权利的力量。”

“要一起么？”

枫溪朝着白玥伸出手来，那双蓝眸平静地望着她，红唇轻启，缓缓道：“姐姐，享受一下万魔之上的权利滋味吧。”

“不……”

白玥慌张地摇头，急忙道：“枫溪，不要再玩弄我了。”

“我不想成为魔族的公主，也不想承认自己的魔族身份。我只是一个生活在牧师圣殿吃着百家饭长大的孤女，跟你们逆天魔龙族没有关系……”

白玥的眼眸红红的，声音也沙哑起来，“我想回家。”

她口中的家自然说的是圣殿联盟。

她的丈夫还在圣殿联盟那边等她回去。

如果不是魔神皇枫秀察觉到了白玥体内的血脉之力，从而把白玥从圣殿联盟带走，白玥这辈子都不会跟魔神皇枫秀和枫溪等人有交流的时候。

她只是想当一个普通人。

结果，这个幻想全部被魔神皇枫秀亲手给打碎了。

白玥当然恨魔神皇枫秀，若非他们之间实力悬殊太大，不然白玥也不会乖乖的跟他回来。

因为她不想由于自己的缘故而让他在驱魔关那边大开杀戒。

她不走，魔神皇枫秀有的是办法让她走。

一想到自己的爱人和驱魔关的生灵们，白玥这才妥协。

如今，来到魔族之后还要面临一个性格有些疯狂的妹妹，这让白玥觉得生活真难。

闻言，枫溪握着白玥的手，轻轻地说着，“姐姐，我知道你内心善良。可是，善良是没有用的啊。”

“你想当一个普通人，是因为你惧怕他人的目光，你不想伤害到任何人。你在恐惧自己的血脉，你在否认自己的本源。因为你在圣殿联盟接受的教育让你觉得这份血脉的存在就是错的。”

“可你是龙，是伟大的逆天魔龙族血脉的拥有者。你不可能跟那些弱小的人类有共同话题的。”

“同样的，他们不会因为你的善良而放过你。因为你的体内流淌着逆天魔龙族皇族的血脉，是魔神皇枫秀的女儿。”

“他们现在能和你和睦相处，是因为他们不知道你的血脉。”

“等这个真相出现之后，他们能接受你的存在么？说白了，非我族类、其心必异。姐姐，只有魔族能包容你的血脉，只有魔族才不会伤害你。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Well, since you don't hate them, I won't say any more."

"Sister, please remember my previous proposal."

"I said, I want you to feel the power of power."

"Want to come together?"

Fengxi stretched out her hand towards Bai Yue, looking at her calmly with her blue eyes, her red lips lightly parted, and she said slowly: "Sister, enjoy the power above all demons."

"No..."

Bai Yue shook her head in panic and said hurriedly: "Fengxi, don't play with me anymore."

"I don't want to be a princess of the Demon Clan, nor do I want to admit my identity as a Demon Clan. I am just an orphan girl who grew up living in the Priest Temple and eating the food of hundreds of families. I have nothing to do with your Heaven-Defying Demon Dragon Clan..."

Bai Yue's eyes were red, and her voice became hoarse, "I want to go home."

The home she mentioned was of course the Temple Alliance.

Her husband is still waiting for her to return with the Temple Alliance.

If Demon God Emperor Fengxiu hadn't noticed the power of blood in Bai Yue's body and took Bai Yue away from the Temple Alliance, Bai Yue would never have interacted with Demon God Emperor Fengxiu, Feng Xi and others in this life.

She just wants to be a normal person.

As a result, all these illusions were shattered by Demon God Emperor Fengxiu himself.

Of course Bai Yue hates the Demon God Emperor Fengxiu. If not for the huge disparity in strength between them, Bai Yue would not have followed him back obediently.

Because she didn't want him to go on a killing spree at the Exorcism Pass because of her.

If she doesn't leave, Demon God Emperor Fengxiu has many ways to make her leave.

When she thought of her lover and the creatures in the Exorcism Pass, Bai Yue compromised.

Now, after coming to the Demon Clan, he has to face a sister with a somewhat crazy personality, which makes Bai Yue feel that life is really difficult.

Hearing this, Fengxi held Bai Yue's hand and said softly, "Sister, I know you are kind in your heart. But kindness is useless."

"You want to be an ordinary person because you are afraid of the eyes of others, and you don't want to hurt anyone. You are afraid of your own bloodline, and you are denying your origin. Because the education you received in the Temple Alliance makes you feel that the existence of this bloodline is wrong."

"But you are a dragon, the owner of the bloodline of the great heaven-defying demonic dragon clan. It is impossible for you to have anything in common with those weak humans."

"Similarly, they will not let you go because of your kindness. Because you have the blood of the royal family of the Heaven-defying Demon Dragon Clan flowing in your body, and you are the daughter of the Demon God Emperor Fengxiu."

"They can live in harmony with you now because they don't know your bloodline."

"After the truth emerges, will they be able to accept your existence? To put it bluntly, those who are not from my race will have different hearts. Sister, only the demons can tolerate your bloodline, and only the demons will not harm you."
